asked.item: Why post went only to company page despite All LinkedIn slot
How to post to both profile and company page

verdict.reason: The pages explain that an All LinkedIn slot does not publish to every destination and that the post's selected destination controls where it publishes.

steps.text: The destination selected on the post controls where it publishes.
A slot labeled All LinkedIn only makes the slot available to posts for any connected LinkedIn destination, and it does not publish one post to every profile and Page.
To publish the same content to a personal profile and a company Page, create one post for each destination.
